research.title: Prediction Interval Coverage Under Covariate Shift
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to examine split conformal prediction under controlled changes in input distributions for regression tasks.
Implemented evaluation routines comparing interval coverage and width across shift conditions, using repeated data splits to characterize variability.

research.title: Probability Calibration in Imbalanced Classification
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to compare probability calibration methods across class imbalance settings, separating model fitting, calibration, and evaluation data.
Evaluated logistic regression and neural classifiers using reliability diagrams, Brier scores, and log loss; examined sensitivity to calibration sample composition.

work.title: Data Validation and Batch Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented Python validation checks for incoming tabular records, handling missing fields, inconsistent types, and duplicate entries before downstream processing.
Maintained batch processing routines and added regression tests for reported defects, documenting expected behavior and failure cases for code review.

projects.title: Regularized Regression with Correlated Predictors
bullets: Implemented ridge and lasso regression comparisons on synthetic and tabular datasets, using standardized predictors and cross validation for penalty selection.
Compared held out prediction error and coefficient stability under correlated features, documenting how regularization affected model sensitivity across repeated splits.

projects.title: Gaussian Mixture Estimation and Cluster Assignment
bullets: Implemented expectation maximization for Gaussian mixture models in NumPy, including covariance regularization and convergence checks for stable parameter estimation.
Compared mixture models with k means on synthetic datasets, examining cluster assignments and sensitivity to initialization under overlapping and anisotropic distributions.
